title: Dashboard command: dashboard to server (contract v0.2, draft)
description: What POST /v1/accounts/{id}/commands receives when a person presses a control (Close now, Auto switch, Next trade lot, TP/SL). The server checks the session, applies the same range checks the bot will, then queues a command for the bot. The reply is in dashboard-command-reply.schema.json.

client_request_id.description: Chosen by the dashboard for each press. A double tap or a retry with the same id queues one command, not two.
